newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shui On Construction to offer 65 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Shui On Construction to offer 65 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Shui On group unit Shui On Construction and Materials Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to offer 65 million shares at HK$9.30 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.

The offer price, which represents a prospective price to earnings multiple of 8.9 times on a weighted average basis, is fixed at the top of the book-building range of HK$7.50 to HK$9.30 a share, the company said in a statement.
This will give Shui On a market capitalisation of HK$2.42 billion, the company said.
Shui On, a construction materials supplier and construction firm, said the IPO will run from January 22-27, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on February 3.
Of the offer, 48.75 million shares will be placed to professional investors in Asia and Europe, with the remaining 16.25 million shares for public subscription in Hong Kong.
The company said half of the HK$574.4 million in net proceeds will be used to expand its construction material operations in China, and the rest for general working capital.
It forecast a profit of not less than HK$210 million for the year ending in March 31, 1997.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd is the global coordinator, sponsor and lead manager of the offer.
The company supplies ready-mixed concrete, rock products, cement and other construction materials in Hong Kong and southern China.
It also is involved in the construction of public housing and institutional buildings.
